Frequency once per 10 minutes. Requirements You wield a gunblade.

Until the start of your next turn, gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against melee attacks and resistance to physical damage equal to half your level (minimum 1). Apply the Camouflage effect. Its AC bonus does not stack with Royal Guard.

Effect: @UUID[Compendium.gunbreaker-pf2e.gunbreaker-effects.Item.47ab3c3e65986371]{Camouflage}. Apply manually after recording the action.
